compoundRigidContact.definition: The vehicle compound rigid body includes four wheel bump-stop cylinders and four vehicle boxes. The count alone does not identify a body shell, wheel, contact object, contact point or severity.
compoundRigidContact.readOnlyGeometryConclusion: At the positive sampled poses the four vehicle boxes remain about 0.30 m above y=0; front wheel bump-stop cylinders slightly cross the ground plane. Ground is the only nearby static AABB candidate. This supports wheel hard-stop contact as an inference, not a captured Cannon pair.
compoundRigidContact.remainingGap: Actual contact pair/shape IDs, contact points, multipliers/forces/impulses and continuous contact timing were not captured. The 20 Hz experiment curve has no rigid-contact field. Zero contact or independently validated impact severity is not established.

visualReview.observed: Chase view shows the car, the lower Weave road, overhead structure and sky. The navigation displays the first left turn and 960 m remaining. Recording, four-wheel support and bench supply are visible; the mounted experimental rear assemblies are visible.
visualReview.limits: A single start image is not video and is not an atomic same-frame telemetry bundle. Software-renderer preview frame rate is not hardware performance.

visualReview.observed: The original UI displays Foundry vehicle entrance reached, 0 km/h and paused. Four experimental rear assemblies, lane markings, pavement borders and the lower street continue into the distance.
visualReview.limits: Foundry facade modules remain repetitive and simplified. The image shows the lower arrival area, not the maintenance court or an ascent to the upper road. It precedes ending/saving the live record.

errorScope: One original console 404 lacks its URL in this operator journal. No pageerror was recorded. Its resource identity is not retrospectively inferred from a different capture.
limitations: One original route from the legal city spawn, using real native keys and the existing physics. The external key chooser is QA operation, not human handling evaluation.

Lower Foundry entrance reached within the existing 8 m arrival radius; the vehicle did not need to touch the exact center coordinate. Upper-road ascent, maintenance court and the full drive-flight challenge remain untested by this run.
This x=100 northbound drive does not prove the separate transverse X crossing at z=-100. Its existing geometry-ray evidence is separate.
Existing bench supply, no wind, clear day and dry road. No flight thrust was requested; 0 kg gas throughput does not establish finite-air flight performance.
Native key receipts are complete in the original application journal; eight external returned lines and one collector telemetry-count difference are explicitly unresolved.
Geometry analysis does not replace unrecorded contact pair/force data, and the route is not described as compound-contact-free.
The two PNGs are original start/end stills, not a full route video. No RGB pixel edits or exposure postprocessing were performed.
